# Shaping Intel — Neutral Relational Facts for the Team That Cuts the Bricks

> This file prescribes nothing. It indexes machine-extracted facts (in `generated/gen-shaping-*.md`)
> a shaping team needs before deciding brick boundaries, parity rules, or distribution.
> Every statement below describes what the generator observed and how it was derived.
> Shaping decisions belong to that team.

## The six matrices (all in `generated/`, regenerated by `build-atlas.ts`)

| # | File | Fact extracted | Derivation | What the shaping team can read from it |
|---|------|----------------|------------|----------------------------------------|
| 1 | `gen-shaping-engine-contracts.md` | Per `src/engines/*` file: `storage/contracts/…` strings referenced (max 10) + governor-touch signal (`chrome-governor`/`BunCdpClient`/`executor/cdp` mention) | Static import-substring scan over all engine files | Which engines read which contracts (reader edges); which files touch the browser path (canon-relevance signal, not a verdict) |
| 2 | `gen-shaping-router-edges.md` | Per server router/route file: engine + contract names referenced (max 8 each) | Static import-substring scan over `src/server/` | Which routers depend on which engines/contracts (wire edges) |
| 3 | `gen-shaping-slot-refs.md` | Per slot id: count + sample of `frontend/src` files containing the id string | Substring scan of 575 frontend files against `SLOT_IDS` from `frontend/src/ui/slots.ts` | Where each slot id is referenced (projection footprint); string presence ≠ render behavior |
| 4 | `gen-shaping-surfaces.md` | Four independent inventories: CLI command files (7), `/api/` prefixes observed (≤60 shown), MCP tool names observed (37: 27 discover + 3 nlcl + 7 browser), slot ids (29) | File walk + regex (`name:'…'`, `server.tool('…'`, `/api/…` literals, `SLOT_IDS`) | The per-surface item lists side by side so the team can cross-reference identity itself; no claim that one item exists on multiple surfaces |
| 5 | `gen-shaping-config-refs.md` | Per tunable key (8 representative of 13): `src/` files mentioning it | Substring scan for keys like `server.port`, `fleet.autoStart`, `storage.dataDir`, `surfaces.enforceParity` | Tunability exposure: which knobs reach into which files |
| 6 | `gen-shaping-test-presence.md` | Per area: file count vs name-matched test count | Basename (minus `-impl`/extension) substring-matched against test paths | Heuristic only — indicates nearby test attention, not coverage |

## Companion facts already in the atlas (no duplication, just pointers)

- File presence for all 2,424 files: `ATLAS-FILES.json` + `generated/gen-*.md` (see `architecture/coverage.md`).
- Table/column inventory (201 models, every `field:Type`): `generated/gen-prisma-columns-system/user.md` + `L4-contracts/prisma-columns.md`.
- Validator exports (38 schema files): `generated/gen-zod-full.md` + `L4-contracts/zod-full.md`.
- Contract→impl→mem matrix (67×71): `L3-file-catalog/storage-parity.md`.
- Router prefixes + MCP/CLI inventories with backing: `L3-file-catalog/server-routers-full.md`, `mcp-cli-full.md`, `api-reference.md`.
- Lifecycle states observed in code (binding `prospect→retired`, program versions, `BindingStatusLog`, boot phases): `architecture/capability-lifecycle.md`, `boot-and-runtime.md`.
- Failure classes + recovery chain: `architecture/error-catalog.md` (40+ `CapStoreError`s, `DEFAULT_RECOVERY`).

## Explicitly out of scope for this file

Brick size, brick boundaries, parity requirements, distribution location, priority order across families, and any recommendation about what to split, merge, or delete. Those are shaping-team decisions; the matrices above are their input.
